args.envNote: There is no Docker in v3. The local server in this container is SQL Server 2022 Express installed natively, a sqlservr process of the mssql user on 127.0.0.1,11434; its SA password is in ~/.dbchange/sql.env, which the fixture tests read (never print it). If it does not answer, run bash ci/sql.sh up (idempotent) before concluding anything. CI runs the same script on Ubuntu, and LocalDB 17.0 through ci/sql.ps1 on windows-latest. DacFx 162.5.57 runs beside the committed 170.5.96 through tests/DacFx162/. Every DacFx plan and publish goes through io/DacFx.Scripted. v2's own CI lanes under .github/workflows/ (ssdt-agent-*, analyzers, verifiability, lint) are the archive's oracle: never edit them, except the catalog lint step WP 2.6 already changed. Disk is limited (about 9 GB free): delete your worktree's bin/ and obj/ when you finish. Date new DECISIONS.md lines 2026-10-21.
args.integrateNotes: Merge every ready branch, in this order: 7.1d, then wp/2.1b-r1 (2.1b), then 3.5c, then wp/2.6 (2.6 moves the most files). Run the fixture lane twice after the last merge and report both runs; DriftTests' read-only trace test must pass both times. Then delete every merged wp/ branch, including wp/2.1b, wp/3.5, wp/3.5-r1, wp/3.5-r2, wp/7.1, wp/7.1-r1, wp/7.1-r2, wp/7.1c, wp/7.1c-r1 and wp/7.1c-r2 once their work is merged, remove every worktree under .claude/worktrees with git worktree remove --force, and delete the worktree-wf_* branches.

wps.title: WP 3.5 completed: the copy build with its last review findings fixed, a declared witness kept from reaching any linked server
wps.brief: WP 3.5 of V3_MILESTONES.md (§9), io/SyntheticCopy and the verb `synthetic-copy up`, the copy build's eight steps (restore or build the base, plant WP 3.8's rows, reproduce trust, run declared witnesses, hash, accept, identity), was built in wave 7 and reviewed through two fix rounds; its latest branch is wp/3.5-r2 (ce722e9). Five findings stay open, in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-outsystems-ddl-exporter/17755096-5809-5c10-a22d-d46e8371455a/scratchpad/specs/wave7-3.5-open.txt; read them in full. The must-fix one is a safety gap: io/Witnesses.cs refuses a declared witness that reaches another server directly (four-part names, OPENQUERY, OPENROWSET, OPENDATASOURCE, synonyms), but admits one that reads a repository view or table-valued function written over a linked server or OPENQUERY, or that writes a table whose trigger does, and blocks run with triggers firing, so such a block could carry a named environment's rows into the copy. Fix it as the finding says: before the first statement that makes or plants anything, read the local server's linked servers (SELECT name, data_source FROM sys.servers WHERE is_linked = 1) and refuse the run as copy.named-host (exit 9) when any linked server's data source resolves, as R15 resolves a host, to a host of a named environment in dbchange/environments.json, which also covers the base publish's seeds and triggers; and have Repository.Of collect every View, ScalarFunction, TableValuedFunction and DmlTrigger whose script holds a server-qualified name or OPENQUERY, OPENROWSET or OPENDATASOURCE, following views over such views, so that Outside refuses a block that names one, or writes a table carrying such a trigger, as witness.not-dml by its line. Pin each with a test that fails without the fix (a fast test over a DacFx model holding CREATE VIEW dbo.RemoteView AS SELECT Name FROM [prod-sql].[Catalog].[dbo].[Customer] and a block reading it; a fixture test with a linked server on the local server whose data source names an environment's host). Fix the four should-fix findings too. Create your branch from the base and merge wp/3.5-r2 into it first. Keep the DECISIONS.md lines one per decision, dated 2026-10-21 for new ones. Per-file budget: 500 lines a code file, 140 characters a line.
